goblin-cavalcade.plan: Deploy a critical mass of hasty and evasive Goblins, attack with low-power bodies to trigger Cavalcade, and use cheap burn or forced-unprofitable blocks to keep damage flowing.

packages.title: Swarm and haste
packages.intro: These cheap attackers establish the wide board and convert early turns into combat damage.

cards.name: Fanatical Firebrand
cards.role: Hasty Goblin that can sacrifice to deal 1 damage to any target.

cards.name: Goblin Instigator
cards.role: Enters and creates a 1/1 Goblin token, adding two bodies for one card.

cards.name: Raging Goblin
cards.role: A 1/1 Goblin with haste that starts attacking immediately.

cards.name: Shambling Goblin
cards.role: Black 1/1 Goblin; when it dies, target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn.

cards.name: Frenzied Goblin
cards.role: When it attacks, paying {R} can make a target creature unable to block this turn.

cards.name: Goblin Trailblazer
cards.role: A 2/1 Goblin with menace, requiring at least two blockers. Its power is too high to trigger Cavalcade without a reduction.

cards.name: Goblin Glory Chaser
cards.role: A 1/1 attacker that gains a +1/+1 counter and becomes renowned after its first combat damage to a player; renowned gives it menace, but its increased power no longer qualifies for Cavalcade.

packages.title: Low-power attack payoffs
packages.intro: This enchantment rewards attacks by your low-power creatures with 1 damage to the player or planeswalker they attack.

cards.name: Cavalcade of Calamity
cards.role: Whenever a creature you control with power 1 or less attacks, this enchantment deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker that creature is attacking.

cards.name: Shock
cards.role: Instant-speed 2 damage to any target, clearing a blocker or providing reach.

cards.name: Volcanic Hammer
cards.role: Sorcery-speed 3 damage to any target.

packages.title: Red mana
packages.intro: Basic red mana keeps the one- and two-mana swarm and burn spells castable on curve.

cards.name: Mountain
cards.role: Basic land that taps for {R}.

kavu-beastmaster.plan: Ramp into oversized Kavu creatures, use red removal to clear combat, and let enters-the-battlefield value and combat keywords turn a creature-heavy midrange board into the winning exchange.

packages.title: Kavu bodies and combat
packages.intro: These Kavu supply creature bodies, first-strike pressure, and entry-trigger value. Horned Kavu can return a red or green creature you control so you can cast it again and reuse an entry trigger.

cards.name: Flametongue Kavu
cards.role: When it enters, it deals 4 damage to target creature; it may target a creature you control.

cards.name: Kavu Howler
cards.role: A 4/5 Kavu that reveals the top four cards and puts all revealed Kavu cards into your hand, with the rest on the bottom.

cards.name: Kavu Chameleon
cards.role: This spell cannot be countered; {G} makes it the color of your choice until end of turn.

cards.name: Kavu Climber
cards.role: A 3/3 Kavu that draws a card when it enters.

cards.name: Caldera Kavu
cards.role: {1}{B} gives it +1/+1 until end of turn, while {G} makes it the color of your choice until end of turn.

cards.name: Horned Kavu
cards.role: When it enters, return a red or green creature you control to its owner's hand, enabling reuse of an entry trigger.

cards.name: Penumbra Kavu
cards.role: When it dies, creates a 3/3 black Kavu creature token.

cards.name: Pouncing Kavu
cards.role: First strike is always present; kicker {2}{R} gives it two +1/+1 counters and haste as it enters.

cards.name: Assault // Battery
cards.role: Assault ({R}) deals 2 damage to any target; Battery ({3}{G}) creates a 3/3 green Elephant token.

packages.title: Land acceleration and fixing
packages.intro: These spells increase land count and smooth both colors so the midrange creatures arrive ahead of schedule.

cards.name: Rampant Growth
cards.role: Searches for a basic land and puts it onto the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Harrow
cards.role: Sacrifices a land to find two basics onto the battlefield untapped, fixing colors while advancing mana.

cards.name: Forest
cards.role: Basic land that taps for {G}.

cards.name: Mountain
cards.role: Basic land that taps for {R}.

cards.name: Shivan Oasis
cards.role: Enters tapped and taps for {R} or {G}; its source quantity remains unchanged.

packages.title: Burn for creature control
packages.intro: Efficient red interaction removes blockers or finishes damaged creatures while the Kavu curve takes over.

cards.name: Incinerate
cards.role: Instant that deals 3 damage to any target; a creature dealt damage this way cannot regenerate this turn.

oldschool-zombie-tribal.plan: Trade creatures freely, recur Zombies from the graveyard, and use tribal lords plus sacrifice outlets to turn disposable bodies into pressure and attrition.

packages.title: Zombie board and lords
packages.intro: These Zombies establish the tribe, scale with its graveyard or board count, and make attacks harder to answer.

cards.name: Diregraf Ghoul
cards.role: A 2/2 Zombie that enters tapped, trading immediate speed for an efficient body.

cards.name: Ghoulraiser
cards.role: When it enters, return a random Zombie card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Abattoir Ghoul
cards.role: First strike; creatures dealt damage by it that die let you gain life equal to their toughness.

cards.name: Lord of the Accursed
cards.role: Other Zombies you control get +1/+1; paying {1}{B} and tapping it gives all Zombies menace until end of turn, including opposing Zombies.

cards.name: Soulless One
cards.role: Its power and toughness each equal the number of Zombies on the battlefield plus Zombie cards in all graveyards.

cards.name: Zombie Master
cards.role: Gives other Zombies swampwalk and regeneration; swampwalk works when an opponent controls a Swamp.

cards.name: Undead Warchief
cards.role: Zombie creatures you control, including itself, get +2/+1, and Zombie spells you cast cost {1} less.

packages.title: Sacrifice and recursion
packages.intro: Sacrifice outlets turn creatures into power or removal, while the recursive body keeps the engine supplied.

cards.name: Gravecrawler
cards.role: Can be cast from your graveyard while you control a Zombie, making it repeatable sacrifice fodder.

cards.name: Carrion Feeder
cards.role: Cannot block. Its activated ability sacrifices a creature to put a +1/+1 counter on it; sacrificing to a different outlet does not trigger this ability.

cards.name: Phyrexian Ghoul
cards.role: Its activated ability sacrifices a creature to give it +2/+2 until end of turn.

cards.name: Fleshbag Marauder
cards.role: On entry, each player sacrifices a creature, turning one body into symmetrical edict removal.

packages.title: Removal and life-for-cards
packages.intro: Spot removal answers creatures while Sign in Blood refuels the attrition plan at a life cost.

cards.name: Doom Blade
cards.role: Instantly destroys a target nonblack creature.

cards.name: Go for the Throat
cards.role: Instantly destroys a target nonartifact creature.

cards.name: Terror
cards.role: Instantly destroys a target nonartifact, nonblack creature; it cannot be regenerated.

cards.name: Sign in Blood
cards.role: Target player draws two cards and loses 2 life.

packages.title: Swamp mana
packages.intro: Basic black mana casts the Zombie curve and activates its black abilities.

cards.name: Swamp
cards.role: Basic land that taps for {B}.

lightning-burn.plan: Spend each mana efficiently on direct damage, use burn to remove blockers or target the opponent, and let a small prowess threat or Eidolon turn the spell density into a fast finish.

packages.title: Direct damage and reach
packages.intro: These spells convert mana into damage to creatures or players, with several options to split, suspend, or reuse damage.

cards.name: Lightning Bolt
cards.role: Instant for 3 damage to any target.

cards.name: Incinerate
cards.role: Instant for 3 damage to any target; a creature hit cannot regenerate this turn.

cards.name: Shock
cards.role: Instant for 2 damage to any target.

cards.name: Searing Blood
cards.role: Deals 2 damage to a target creature; if that creature dies this turn, it deals 3 damage to that creature's controller.

cards.name: Searing Blaze
cards.role: Deals 1 damage to a target player or planeswalker and 1 damage to a creature that player or planeswalker's controller controls; landfall raises both to 3.

cards.name: Forked Bolt
cards.role: Deals 2 damage divided as you choose among one or two targets.

cards.name: Firebolt
cards.role: Deals 2 damage to any target and has flashback for {4}{R}.

cards.name: Fireblast
cards.role: You may sacrifice two Mountains rather than pay its mana cost; it then deals 4 damage to any target.

cards.name: Volcanic Hammer
cards.role: Sorcery-speed 3 damage to any target.

cards.name: Rift Bolt
cards.role: Suspended for {R} to deal 3 damage next upkeep, or cast normally for {2}{R}.

cards.name: Lava Spike
cards.role: Sorcery that deals 3 damage to target player or planeswalker.

packages.title: Spell-fueled attackers
packages.intro: These creatures pressure life totals while the deck continues casting cheap spells.

cards.name: Monastery Swiftspear
cards.role: Haste and prowess make it larger whenever you cast a noncreature spell that turn.

cards.name: Eidolon of the Great Revel
cards.role: Whenever a player casts a spell with mana value 3 or less, it deals 2 damage to that player.

packages.title: Red mana
packages.intro: Untapped red mana supports the low curve and keeps Fireblast available as reach.

cards.name: Mountain
cards.role: Basic land that taps for {R}.

rg-eldrazi-ramp-stompy.plan: Accelerate through basic-land ramp, stabilize with a few sweepers and bodies, then cast colorless Eldrazi whose size and cast or death triggers overwhelm the board.

packages.title: Land-ramp ladder
packages.intro: These spells put extra lands into play or hand so the deck reaches its expensive threats without Elves.

cards.name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
cards.role: Sacrifices to search for a basic land and put it onto the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Farseek
cards.role: Searches for a Plains, Island, Swamp, or Mountain and puts it onto the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Search for Tomorrow
cards.role: Searches for a basic land and puts it onto the battlefield untapped; suspend 2—{G} delays the cast.

cards.name: Cultivate
cards.role: Puts one basic land onto the battlefield tapped and one into your hand.

cards.name: Kodama's Reach
cards.role: Puts one basic land onto the battlefield tapped and one into your hand.

cards.name: Skyshroud Claim
cards.role: Searches for up to two Forest cards and puts them onto the battlefield, even if they are nonbasic Forests.

packages.title: Eldrazi finishers and engines
packages.intro: The high end supplies trampling attackers, cast-trigger interaction, and death-based token value.

cards.name: Ulamog's Crusher
cards.role: An 8/8 with annihilator 2 and must attack each combat if able.

cards.name: It That Betrays
cards.role: Annihilator 2, and whenever an opponent sacrifices a nontoken permanent, you put that card onto the battlefield under your control.

cards.name: Artisan of Kozilek
cards.role: Annihilator 2; when cast, it returns a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: Pawn of Ulamog
cards.role: Creates a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn token whenever it or another nontoken creature you control dies; Spawn can sacrifice for {C}.

cards.name: Conduit of Ruin
cards.role: When cast, may search for a colorless creature card with mana value 7 or greater, put it on top, and the first creature spell each turn costs {2} less.

packages.title: Red stabilization
packages.intro: Early red interaction buys the turns needed to reach the Eldrazi curve.

cards.name: Lightning Bolt
cards.role: Instant for 3 damage to any target.

cards.name: Pyroclasm
cards.role: Deals 2 damage to each creature, clearing most early boards.

packages.title: Two-color land base
packages.intro: These lands supply the ramp spells and red interaction while preserving the supplied quantities.

cards.name: Karplusan Forest
cards.role: Taps for {C}, or for {R} or {G} while dealing 1 damage to you.

cards.name: Gruul Turf
cards.role: Enters tapped, returns a land to your hand, and taps for {R}{G}.

cards.name: Forest
cards.role: Basic land that taps for {G}.

cards.name: Mountain
cards.role: Basic land that taps for {R}.

theros-boros-soldiers.plan: Build a wide Soldier board, target your own heroic creatures with combat tricks, and use counters, attack-wide payoffs, and efficient removal to win combat.

packages.title: Heroic and +1/+1 counters
packages.intro: Cast your own targeted spells on heroic creatures, then convert the resulting counters or tokens into a stronger attack.

cards.name: Akroan Crusader
cards.role: Heroic: whenever you cast a spell that targets it, create a hasty 1/1 red Soldier token.

cards.name: Akroan Sergeant
cards.role: First strike and renown 1: combat damage to a player puts a +1/+1 counter on it once.

cards.name: Bloodcrazed Hoplite
cards.role: Heroic puts a +1/+1 counter on it; whenever a +1/+1 counter is put on it, remove a +1/+1 counter from target creature an opponent controls.

cards.name: Battlewise Hoplite
cards.role: Heroic puts a +1/+1 counter on it, then scry 1.

cards.name: Phalanx Leader
cards.role: Heroic puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

cards.name: Akroan Hoplite
cards.role: Gets +X/+0 when it attacks, where X is the number of attacking creatures you control.

cards.name: Gods Willing
cards.role: Targets a creature you control to give it protection from a color and scries 1; that targeting can trigger heroic.

packages.title: Soldier-wide pressure
packages.intro: Token makers and attack triggers widen the board so the hoplites and denizen convert numbers into damage.

cards.name: Court Street Denizen
cards.role: Whenever another white creature you control enters, tap target creature an opponent controls; Raise the Alarm supplies two white entry triggers.

cards.name: Raise the Alarm
cards.role: Instant that creates two 1/1 white Soldier tokens.

cards.name: Alesha's Vanguard
cards.role: A 3/3 Orc with dash {2}{B}, giving it haste and returning it to hand at the next end step when dashed.

packages.title: Protection and removal
packages.intro: These spells protect key attackers or remove blockers without changing the submitted list.

cards.name: Lightning Bolt
cards.role: Instant for 3 damage to any target.

packages.title: Boros mana
packages.intro: The supplied Plains and Mountains cast the white heroic curve and red interaction; Temple adds scry at a tapped-land cost.

cards.name: Temple of Triumph
cards.role: Enters tapped, scries 1, and taps for {R} or {W}.

cards.name: Plains
cards.role: Basic land that taps for {W}.

cards.name: Mountain
cards.role: Basic land that taps for {R}.

azorius-control.plan: Trade one-for-one early, sculpt draws, sweep the board when needed, and win behind resilient flying finishers while maintaining countermagic.

packages.title: Countermagic and answers
packages.intro: Permission protects the control plan on the stack while Pacifism and sweepers answer permanents that resolve.

cards.name: Counterspell
cards.role: Counters any target spell for {U}{U}.

cards.name: Mana Leak
cards.role: Counters a target spell unless its controller pays {3}.

cards.name: Negate
cards.role: Counters a target noncreature spell.

cards.name: Dissipate
cards.role: Exiles a target spell it counters.

cards.name: Pacifism
cards.role: Aura that prevents enchanted creature from attacking or blocking.

cards.name: Wrath of God
cards.role: Destroys all creatures; they cannot be regenerated.

cards.name: Supreme Verdict
cards.role: Cannot be countered and destroys all creatures.

packages.title: Card selection and advantage
packages.intro: Cheap selection finds lands or answers while the larger draw spells refill after trading resources.

cards.name: Brainstorm
cards.role: Draws three, then puts two cards from hand on top of the library.

cards.name: Opt
cards.role: Scries 1, then draws a card at instant speed.

cards.name: Fact or Fiction
cards.role: Reveals five cards; an opponent separates them into piles and you take one pile into hand.

packages.title: Airborne finishers
packages.intro: Once opposing threats are controlled, these flyers end the game while resisting common answers.

cards.name: Mahamoti Djinn
cards.role: A 5/6 flying creature with no additional ability, providing a large evasive clock.

cards.name: Sphinx of Jwar Isle
cards.role: A 5/5 flying shroud creature, difficult for targeted removal to answer.

cards.name: Sphinx of Magosi
cards.role: A 6/6 flyer that can pay {2}{U} to draw a card and put a +1/+1 counter on it.

packages.title: Azorius mana
packages.intro: The lands provide the blue-heavy permission base and white needed for removal and sweepers.

cards.name: Azorius Chancery
cards.role: Enters tapped, returns a land to hand, and taps for {W}{U}.

cards.name: Meandering River
cards.role: Enters tapped and taps for {W} or {U}.

cards.name: Island
cards.role: Basic land that taps for {U}.

cards.name: Plains
cards.role: Basic land that taps for {W}.

simic-evasive-tempo-midrange.plan: Use cheap selection and land development to deploy evasive creatures, reuse enter-the-battlefield interaction, and turn untap engines plus tempo spells into a sustained midrange advantage.

packages.title: Evasive and tempo creatures
packages.intro: These creatures pressure from the air or repeatedly reset opposing creatures while the deck develops.

cards.name: Coiling Oracle
cards.role: When it enters, reveal the top card: a land goes onto the battlefield (not inherently tapped); any other card goes into your hand.

cards.name: Trygon Predator
cards.role: A flying attacker whose combat damage to a player may destroy an artifact or enchantment that player controls.

cards.name: Man-o'-War
cards.role: When it enters, return target creature to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Peregrine Drake
cards.role: A flying creature that untaps up to five lands when it enters, allowing those lands to be used again for interaction or another spell.

cards.name: Prophet of Kruphix
cards.role: Gives your creatures flash and untaps all creatures and lands you control during each other player's untap step.

cards.name: Simic Sky Swallower
cards.role: A 6/6 flying trampler with shroud, serving as a hard-to-target finisher.

packages.title: Land and card development
packages.intro: These spells increase land count or draw through the deck so the tempo threats and interaction stay online.

cards.name: Explore
cards.role: Draws a card and allows an additional land play this turn.

cards.name: Compulsive Research
cards.role: Target player draws three cards, then discards two cards unless they discard a land card; usually refuels your own hand.

cards.name: Deep Analysis
cards.role: Target player draws two cards for {3}{U}; flashback costs {1}{U} and 3 life, then exiles the spell.

cards.name: Urban Evolution
cards.role: Draws three cards and allows an additional land play this turn.

packages.title: Countermagic and reset
packages.intro: Permission and bounce preserve the tempo lead and protect the larger evasive threats.

cards.name: Counterspell
cards.role: Counters any target spell for {U}{U}.

cards.name: Remand
cards.role: Counters a target spell and returns it to its owner's hand, then draws you a card.

packages.title: Simic mana
packages.intro: The land base supplies both colors while the bounce land trades an immediate land for two mana later.

cards.name: Simic Growth Chamber
cards.role: Enters tapped, returns a land to hand, and taps for {G}{U}.

cards.name: Woodland Stream
cards.role: Enters tapped and taps for {G} or {U}.

cards.name: Island
cards.role: Basic land that taps for {U}.

cards.name: Forest
cards.role: Basic land that taps for {G}.

mono-white-lifegain-sunbond-heroic.plan: Gain life repeatedly, grow Sunbond and lifegain payoffs, then use heroic spells and wide token attacks to turn a defensive start into an evasive, counter-heavy finish.

packages.title: Life-gain engine and payoffs
packages.intro: Repeated life gain supplies the counters and life buffer that make the deck's creatures scale.

cards.name: Soulmender
cards.role: Taps to gain 1 life.

cards.name: Ajani's Pridemate
cards.role: Whenever you gain life, it gets a +1/+1 counter.

cards.name: Wall of Essence
cards.role: Defender; whenever it is dealt combat damage, you gain that much life.

cards.name: Sungrace Pegasus
cards.role: Flying and lifelink make it an evasive recurring source of life gain.

cards.name: Sunbond
cards.role: Aura that puts that many +1/+1 counters on enchanted creature whenever you gain life.

cards.name: Dawnbringer Charioteers
cards.role: Flying and lifelink; heroic puts a +1/+1 counter on it.

cards.name: Archetype of Courage
cards.role: Gives your creatures first strike and prevents opponents' creatures from having first strike.

packages.title: Heroic counters and creature growth
packages.intro: Cast your own targeted spells on heroic creatures, then use the counters to build a dominant board.

cards.name: Phalanx Leader
cards.role: Heroic puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

cards.name: Tethmos High Priest
cards.role: Heroic returns a creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: Paragon of New Dawns
cards.role: Other white creatures you control get +1/+1. Paying {W} and tapping it gives another target white creature you control vigilance until end of turn.

cards.name: Silent Sentinel
cards.role: Flying; whenever it attacks, it returns an enchantment card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: Soul of Theros
cards.role: Can give your creatures +2/+2, first strike, and lifelink until end of turn from the graveyard or battlefield.

cards.name: Heliod's Pilgrim
cards.role: When it enters, searches your library for an Aura card and puts it into your hand.

packages.title: Targeted support and wide attacks
packages.intro: These spells trigger heroic when they target your creatures, while token and tap effects make combat favorable.

cards.name: Mortal's Ardor
cards.role: Gives target creature +1/+1 and lifelink until end of turn. Casting it on your own heroic creature can trigger heroic while combat damage supplies life gain.

cards.name: Divine Favor
cards.role: Aura that gives enchanted creature +1/+3 and you 3 life; casting it targeting a creature can trigger heroic.

cards.name: Oppressive Rays
cards.role: Aura that taxes the enchanted creature's attacks, blocks, and activated abilities by {3}.

cards.name: Excoriate
cards.role: Sorcery that exiles a tapped target creature.

cards.name: Glimpse the Sun God
cards.role: Pay {X}{W} to tap X target creatures, then scry 1. It can clear blockers or target your own heroic creatures after they have attacked.

cards.name: Launch the Fleet
cards.role: Strive costs {1} for each target beyond the first. Until end of turn, each targeted creature creates a tapped and attacking 1/1 white Soldier token whenever it attacks.

cards.name: Pillar of Light
cards.role: Exiles a target creature with toughness 4 or greater.

cards.name: Solemn Offering
cards.role: Destroys target artifact or enchantment and gains you 4 life.

cards.name: Evangel of Heliod
cards.role: When it enters, creates a number of 1/1 white Soldier tokens equal to your devotion to white.

packages.title: White mana
packages.intro: Basic Plains cast the white curve and leave the deck's life and counter engines color-consistent.

cards.name: Plains
cards.role: Basic land that taps for {W}.
